newsitem.title: USA: Pac Bell signs 51,000 to Internet service.
newsitem.headline: Pac Bell signs 51,000 to Internet service.

text.p: Pacific Telesis Group unit Pacific Bell Internet Services said on Thursday it had enrolled more than 51,000 subscribers for its Net access service since it began serving consumers and small businesses on May 28.

"We're thrilled with the tremendous response we've received so far and in our ability to consistently deliver superior customer service and support," said Rick Hronicek, president of Pacific Bell Internet Services.
Billing time averages over two million minutes of daily use during peak periods, Hronicek said.
Browser software has been delivered to customers within an average of four calendar days, and those who have downloaded it are up and running in less than an hour, he said.
Over 70 percent of subscribers are having the service billed directly to their monthly Pacific Bell telephone bill, although it can be charged to a credit card.
